steps.caption: Open Today, then its Overview tab.
The Morning brief card. It appears here and as a pinned Ask AI chat — nothing is emailed.
Opt in: tick 'Send me a brief every weekday at'.
Keep 08:00 IST, or pick another time.
Now it says when it arrives: weekdays at 08:00.
Don't want to wait? Build today's brief now.
The counts: meetings, follow-ups, signals, lease windows, approvals. A failed source is named, never hidden.
It opens as a conversation in Ask AI — ask follow-up questions right below it.
